items.mainDefect: FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym before .compact, so a nil default locale raises NoMethodError in the translate path and in ensure_loaded!.

secondary.defect: I18n.locale is a String while the other fallback entries are Symbols, so uniq does not dedupe 'en'/:en and the same .en.yml is loaded twice.
